uniteDbPokemon.notes: Batch-01 mechanics survey used descriptions, true_desc, notes, buffs, cooldowns, levels, and formulas from this public JSON.

passiveEffects.name: Solar Power
passiveEffects.originalDescription: When the user uses a move, it deals additional damage but loses 5% of its current HP. This Ability's effect does not trigger when the user is in tall grass. When the user deals damage with a basic attack to opposing Pokémon that have been burned by its moves, the user restores 2% of its missing HP.

normalAttackEffects.name: Attack
normalAttackEffects.originalDescription: Breathes fire at opposing Pokémon, dealing damage 4 times per basic attack. Charizard may move while attacking but is slowed by 5% while breathing fire. Charizard deals additional damage to opposing Pokémon that have been burned by the user's moves. This additional damage cannot land critical hits; additional damage benefits from regular lifesteal. Basic attacks gain increased range upon evolving into Charmeleon and into Charizard. When mega evolving into Mega Charizard X, basic attack range is decreased but width is increased.

moveEffects.name: Flame Burst
moveEffects.originalDescription: Attack with a bursting flame. When this move hits, it leaves enemies burned and increases the user's movement speed for a short time. The user attacks with a flame in the designated direction which bursts on the first opposing Pokémon hit or after traveling max distance, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and burning them for 4s (dealing damage 5 times). When this move hits, the user's movement speed is increased by 20% for 3s. The Attack of opposing Pokémon burned by this move is decreased by 5%.

moveEffects.name: Fire Spin
moveEffects.originalDescription: Encircles enemies in the area of effect in a vortex of fire. After this move hits, it deals damage over time and decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time. The user shoots fire in the designated direction which bursts into a vortex of fire on the first opposing Pokémon hit or after traveling max distance, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. The vortex of fire remains for 5s, dealing damage over time to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 0.5s (up to 10 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 25% for 1s when hit.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Seismic Slam
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: The user briefly becomes unstoppable and grabs the designated Pokémon from the opposing team. The target is bound, and the user and the target become invincible as the user flies up then slams them onto the ground, damaging the target and nearby opposing Pokémon, dealing an additional 8% max HP damage to each opposing Pokémon hit. The user then mega evolves into Mega Charizard X for 20 seconds. During Mega evolution, Mega Charizard X receives 50% movement speed increase. Unite buffs: 20% Max HP Shield
